food_court.name: Dostana
food_court.subtitle: Your food. Your way.
food_court.description: Explore food from your favourite spots at Dostana.

menu.name: Chicken Shawarma
menu.description: Slow-roasted spiced chicken wrapped in soft rumali roti with garlic toum, pickles, and crispy fries inside.

menu.name: Special Chicken Shawarma
menu.description: Extra loaded juicy shredded chicken with double garlic cream, jalapeños, and melted cheese drizzle.

menu.name: Chicken Roll
menu.description: Smoky chicken tikka tossed with onions, capsicum, and tangy mint mayo wrapped in a flaky paratha.

menu.name: Paneer Roll
menu.description: Succulent spiced paneer cubes sautéed with peppers and house masala sauce in a warm toasted roll.

menu.name: Loaded Shawarma
menu.description: Chef special grand platter-style shawarma packed with roasted chicken, mozzarella, peri-peri spice, and hummus.

menu.name: French Fries
menu.description: Golden crispy potato fries seasoned with Dostana peri-peri spice dust and served with garlic mayo dip.

menu.name: Plain Dosa
menu.description: Golden-brown crisp fermented rice crepe served with piping hot sambar, coconut chutney, and tomato chutney.

menu.name: Masala Dosa
menu.description: Iconic crispy dosa smeared with butter and stuffed with tempered turmeric potato masala. Served with chutneys & sambar.

menu.name: Idli
menu.description: Plate of 2 steamed cloud-soft rice cakes served soaked in fragrant drumstick sambar and fresh coconut dip.

menu.name: Vada
menu.description: Plate of 2 crispy golden medu vadas made with spiced urad dal, curry leaves, and ginger. Served with sambar.

menu.name: Mysore Masala Dosa
menu.description: Signature crispy dosa layered with fiery red garlic chutney paste, melted butter, and spiced potato sabzi.

menu.name: Idli Vada Combo
menu.description: The best of both worlds: 1 steamed soft idli + 1 crunchy medu vada with generous sambar and two chutneys.

menu.name: Cutting Chai
menu.description: Classic Mumbai street style half-glass kadak brewed strong tea with whole milk and cardamom.

menu.name: Masala Chai
menu.description: Aromatic tea infused with hand-crushed cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, and fresh ginger.

menu.name: Ginger Tea
menu.description: Zesty and invigorating tea simmered with fresh crushed adrak, soothing and refreshing.

menu.name: Coffee
menu.description: South Indian style frothy filter coffee decoction whipped with creamy milk and rich aroma.

menu.name: Cold Coffee
menu.description: Chilled thick blended coffee with chocolate drizzle and vanilla ice cream scoop.

menu.name: Samosa
menu.description: Golden flaky pastry stuffed with spicy potato and peas filling. Served with sweet tamarind and green mint chutney.

vendors.name: Quick Bites & Chaat
vendors.short_desc: Mumbai pav bhaji, sev puri, crunchy loaded nachos & ice slushes
